description: This file defines Kubernetes RBAC namespace roles and role bindings for bootstrap policies, including roles for system components and namespace-specific permissions.

methods.name: addNamespaceRole
methods.description: Adds a role to a namespace, ensuring the namespace starts with 'kube-' and the role is not already registered.

methods.name: addNamespaceRoleBinding
methods.description: Adds a role binding to a namespace, ensuring the namespace starts with 'kube-' and the binding is not already registered.

methods.name: NamespaceRoles
methods.description: Returns the map of namespace to roles to create.

methods.name: NamespaceRoleBindings
methods.description: Returns the map of namespace to role bindings to create.
